tool: Built-in image_gen image editing and generation
reference: The user's Daniel, Max, Mary, Leopold and Leila drawings, the realistic rear-view character collage, and the treeless meadow developed in this conversation.

assets.role: Five realistic detectives, rear-view standing and hand-casting poses, with transparent backgrounds.
assets.prompt: Create a photorealistic GAME SPRITE ATLAS based on these exact five orange/yellow detectives. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. EXACT uniform 5-column by 2-row grid of TEN FULL-BODY CHARACTER CUTOUTS, every cell equal size. No labels, text, borders, scenery, ground, shadows or extra objects. Left-to-right columns: Daniel short black hair orange suit yellow crossed shoulder straps orange boots; Max light brown hair orange sleeves yellow torso panel orange trousers yellow boots; Mary shoulder-length brown hair orange jacket yellow collar yellow trousers; Leopold short brown hair yellow torso orange sleeves orange trousers yellow boots; Leila auburn bob yellow outfit orange panels yellow boots. Preserve these exact characters' realistic style, outfits, hair and back designs from the reference. Both rows show EVERY character strictly FROM BEHIND, with whole head-to-foot body visible and natural human proportions. TOP ROW: neutral upright standing pose, empty hands at sides. BOTTOM ROW: same person facing away in an action casting pose, both arms slightly spread and forearms raised forward at chest height, empty palms aimed toward the distance, no visual lightning yet. Consistent camera distance and lighting; aligned head heights and boot baselines in each row. Each figure centered horizontally in their own cell, plenty of transparent padding 15% around each figure, no figure crosses its cell. Keep all ten separate and uncropped. Fine fabric textures, realistic skin and hair. All fully clothed. This will be cropped into ten sprites for a third-person browser game. Large wide atlas.

Create a clean photorealistic background plate from this meadow. Remove the entire person in the center and seamlessly replace them with matching natural grass and flowers. Keep the same realistic treeless rolling grassy field, blue sky, sunny clouds, natural soil banks and pond on the right, wide third-person game camera angle. No people, animals, weapons, text, UI or trees anywhere. Slightly flatten a natural central grassy path leading into the distance to make the ground easy to read in a game, preserving the meadow aesthetic. Wide landscape background suitable for a third-person adventure game.

assets.role: Three realistic large guards, standing and energy-casting poses, with transparent backgrounds.
assets.prompt: Photorealistic video-game CHARACTER SPRITE ATLAS, transparent background, EXACT uniform 3 columns by 2 rows, six separate full-body cutouts. Three fictional big muscular adult GUARDS, bulky fully clothed science-fiction adversaries, facing FRONT toward the viewer, whole bodies head to boots with no cropping. Dark charcoal rugged padded suits, heavy boots, black high collars, subtle purple electric glowing glove accents, stern expressions, natural realistic skin and anatomy, cinematic outdoor daylight. Column1: broad bald light-skinned guard, dark gray suit. Column2: tall dark-skinned guard with short cropped hair, navy-black suit. Column3: extra-big broad guard with short dark hair, black/purple reinforced suit. TOP ROW neutral stance arms slightly away from body. BOTTOM ROW corresponding same three guards with both hands extended in a supernatural energy-casting stance, violet glow around palms but no long rays. No guns or other weapons, no injury or violence scene, just costume character assets. Uniform equal cells, aligned head heights and boot baselines, each figure centered with 15% transparent margin. No labels, no text, no gridlines, no scenery, no ground, no shadows. Realistic photographic character cutouts for a fantasy lightning game.

assets.role: Two opposite full-body footsteps for each detective, used in a distance-driven walking loop with the standing passing pose.
assets.prompt: Photorealistic rear-view walking-animation sprite sheet. Exactly TEN COMPLETE FULL-BODY people in an evenly spaced 5-column, 2-row grid. Transparent background, wide landscape composition. SAME FIVE DETECTIVES as reference, columns Daniel / Max / Mary / Leopold / Leila with the same orange-yellow clothing, back designs and hair. Top and bottom rows MUST BE DIFFERENT WALKING STRIDES: TOP ROW each detective's LEFT leg is forward (away from camera), RIGHT leg is trailing toward camera with its right boot heel/sole lifted and visible; LEFT arm swings back and RIGHT arm forward. BOTTOM ROW each detective's RIGHT leg is forward, LEFT leg is trailing toward camera with LEFT boot heel/sole lifted and visible; RIGHT arm swings back and LEFT arm forward. These are two opposite footsteps, not identical poses and not standing still. All ten bodies are viewed strictly from behind. Maintain exact character identity and costume without mirroring their clothes. Full bodies including ALL heads, BOTH hands, BOTH complete legs and ALL BOOTS, with at least 10% transparent margin above heads and below feet. Two rows ONLY. No cropped figures or missing lower legs. All cells same size and camera distance, figures same height, neatly centered. Ground-contact feet aligned per row. Realistic anatomy, fabric and hair, natural walking arm and leg movements. No labels, words, gridlines, scenery, shadows or effects. Match photographic quality of reference.

integration: Original generated PNGs are stored here. art-data.js records source rectangles for runtime sprite rendering. No asset depends on a temporary path or external image service.
